definitions.gloss: to recover; to rally; to pick up
definitions.explanation: to return to a better state after a decline, especially regarding health, weather, or conditions

examples.japanese: ⟦{病状|びょうじょう}→病状：21011_byoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{持|も}ち{直|なお}した。
⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{持|も}ち{直|なお}してきた。
⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{持|も}ち{直|なお}しつつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Stock prices are finally starting to recover.

notes:
USAGE:
- ⟦{病状|びょうじょう}→病状：21011_byoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{持|も}ち{直|なお}す (condition improves)
- ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{持|も}ち{直|なお}す (weather improves)
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{持|も}ち{直|なお}す (economy recovers)
Implies gradual recovery from a difficult situation. Often used for health, weather, and economic conditions.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{盛|も}り{返|かえ}す→盛り返す：08202_morikaesu⟧ (to rally - similar, more active)
- ⟦{回復|かいふく}する→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧ (to recover - more formal)
- ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold - base verb)
